name: MUSE · Global Pipeline (chat AI agent → Atlas → n8n)

parameters.content:
## MUSE · Global Pipeline — chat AI agent → Atlas → n8n
Full end-to-end mirror of one MUSE turn. A chat message enters at the Atlas **Neural Conversation** (`/chat`, Crown deck) and flows through the runtime pipeline:

**perceive → recollect → classify → build_prompt → decide → gate (AXIOM) → delegate → speak**

The atomic turn runs server-side in `runtime.py::JarvisPrime.handle()` behind `POST /v1/jarvis/chat`. n8n mirrors every stage, reads the Atlas evidence surfaces live, enforces the owner gate, and performs the **delegate** hop to the connector layer.

**Invariant:** *Intelligence proposes; the verifier disposes.* n8n is the **execution + connector** layer, never the verifier — the AXIOM gate stays in MUSE.
Set n8n env vars `MUSE_COCKPIT_URL` (default `http://host.docker.internal:8765`), `MUSE_COCKPIT_TOKEN`, `MUSE_N8N_BASE` (default `http://localhost:5678`).

### ▲ CROWN DECK
Command · governance · integrity.
Stations: Atlas Crown `/atlas`, Neural Conversation `/chat`, Quarantine Moon `/axiom`, Steering `/steer`.
Entry, gate, owner-gate, ledger, speak.

**perceive→classify→decide→gate→speak** all happen inside this one streamed call (`gateway/cockpit/agent.py::jarvis_responder` → `JarvisPrime.handle`). Response is NDJSON (`phase, body, body_delta, detail, approval, evidence, ledger, done`).

### ◆ OBSERVATORY DECK — Atlas read-back (live cockpit reads mirror the internal stages)
`GET /v1/cockpit/axiom` gate+hash-chain · `GET /v1/cockpit/ledger` delegation ledger · `GET /v1/cockpit/memory/tree` recollect · `GET /v1/cockpit/evidence` retrieve→rank→cite→verify · `GET /v1/cockpit/autonomy` steering · `GET /v1/cockpit/approvals` owner queue.
The six disabled nodes below document each endpoint/station; the **Atlas read-back** Code node calls them all live.

**8 gates** (`hermes_cli/jarvis_prime/gates.py`): planning · build · review · test · security · release · owner_approval · rollback. Profiles: LOW→build,test · MED→6 · HIGH→all 8. Release gate also fails if the AXIOM chain is invalid.

parameters.content:
### ✦ FLIGHT / FOUNDRY / EMBASSY decks (delegate targets)
**Flight** — delegate_to workers/agents (fleet fan-out). **Foundry** — release gate `/release`, fabrication. **Embassy** — `post_publicly` / Signal Broadcast `/share` is owner-gated.
The DELEGATE hop mirrors `JarvisPrime.delegate()` and the `N8nBridge` contract: `{ idempotency_key, verified_by, payload }` + `Idempotency-Key` header, ret/backoff, ledger append.
